title: Nonnegativity of the product $L^p$ norm
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, let $p\in\mathbb R$, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. The product $L^p$ quantity
\[
\left(\mathbb E\,|f|^p\right)^{1/p}
\]
is nonnegative, where the expectation is taken under the independent product distribution with marginal $\pi$.
